description: This file is a shell script (bash/sh) that provides command-line functionality for managing a Git web interface server, including start, stop, and restart actions. It configures and launches various types of web servers (like Apache, Lighttpd, WEBrick, Python HTTP server, etc.) to serve gitweb, using configurations specific to each server type. It also handles checking for server readiness and optionally opens a web browser to browse gitweb.

methods.name: resolve_full_httpd
methods.description: Resolves the full path to the specified HTTP daemon executable based on the configuration and environment, handling different server types like apache2, lighttpd, plackup, webbrick, python, and default lookup.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the configured web server with appropriate configuration, handling processes, creation of config files, and background execution as needed.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the running web server by killing the process using the stored PID.

methods.name: httpd_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if the web server has started and is ready by attempting to connect to its port.

methods.name: lighttpd_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration file for Lighttpd web server to serve gitweb.

methods.name: apache2_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration file for Apache2 web server to serve gitweb, including module loading and CGI setup.

methods.name: webrick_conf
methods.description: Generates a Ruby script to run WEBrick server configured to serve gitweb.

methods.name: python_conf
methods.description: Generates a Python script to run a simple CGI server for gitweb.

methods.name: gitweb_conf
methods.description: Creates a Perl configuration file for gitweb.

methods.name: configure_httpd
methods.description: Calls the appropriate configuration function based on the specified web server type.
